rows.text: a Sole Arbitrator (Madras HC-appointed) partly allows Larsen & Toubro's claim, ordering Texmo to pay **Rs 25.66 crore** plus 8% annual interest and costs; Texmo's own counter-claim of Rs 23.51 crore was dismissed as outside the arbitration's scope, with recourse to other fora left open — recovered, blank in the baseline.
allots 15,30,000 preferential shares at Rs 45.65 to promoters Sanjay Kumar Agrawal and Rashmi Agrawal, for **Rs 6.98 crore**.
received NSE and BSE in-principle approval for its proposed preferential issue of up to **15.30 lakh equity shares** to the proposed allottees.
replies to NSE surveillance that it **holds no undisclosed price-sensitive information** and that the movement in its share price is market driven.
